package.name: g1_locomotion
package.description: Safety-critical bridge to the Unitree G1 onboard high-level locomotion: maps /cmd_vel (Twist vx,vy,vyaw) to LocoClient SetVelocity with velocity and acceleration limits, slew-rate limiting, a command watchdog, and an SDK-side duration TTL; republishes the G1 LowState as /joint_states (incl. waist_yaw), /g1/body_imu, and /g1/loco_status; exposes /g1/halt and /g1/set_mode.
package.author: Rohan
